notes.addresses: Unslid shared-cache addresses only. MultitouchHID and SpringBoard executable offsets are in T5 report; they do not use the shared-cache slide.
notes.mt_contact_filled: x25 points at 96-byte MTContact just filled, before callbacks; x24 is path storage.
notes.mt_contact_callback: Immediately before blr x8: x1 packed MTContacts, x2 count, x3 frame, x8 plugin callback.
notes.hid_digitizer_finger: x2 path index, x3 identity, x4 event mask, x5 range, x6 touching; d0..d7 contain floating fields (not in general register log).
notes.identity: Observe identity.process: UIKit hooks apply to every process sharing the cache.
notes.dumps: Use --hook-dump mt_contact_filled=x25:96 --hook-dump mt_contact_callback=x1:96 --hook-dump mt_process_contacts=x1:80 --hook-dump mt_forward_binary=x2:30 --hook-dump mt_surface_descriptor=x0:16
